versions.localizedDescription:
## Highlights

Write community posts in Markdown with a preview. Keep your preferred community sort order between launches. Change your username with a rename card.

## Fixes

- Reader title bar now hides with the controls (#213).
- Status bar hides correctly after toast messages (#213).
- Chapter title and page number remain visible with controls hidden (#213).
- Fixed title bar animation on the Duo inner display (#213).
- Fixed layout shifts when opening pages on Duo (#214).
- Post italics, underlines and strikethroughs render correctly (#214).
- Chinese text now displays in italics (#214).
- Post images stay within their table cells (#217).
- Large page titles collapse correctly when scrolling (#216).

## Other changes

- Added human verification when requesting registration and password-reset codes (#215).
- Updated shop item usage to follow server availability and results (#215).
- Updated CELIA branding.
